title: The lane sweep reads session summaries first, and messages only lanes whose status is unclear
why: Lane token-spend-sources (session_013NEJL2ffE4xixcyVkMbpuV), 12:16 CST Nov 8, measured: each sweep reply cost $1.45-$2.42, all to reload an expired one-hour cache, and the post_turn_summary from get_session or list_sessions already held the answer; the 11:28 sweep cost about $125-$610 on the lane side. Related: step idle-lane-archive-at-merge.
